reel.caption:
Buying ₹1 lakh of gold jewellery this Diwali: why is the bill ₹1,13,500?

GST on gold jewellery is 3% of the gold value: ₹3,000 on ₹1 lakh.
Making charges are extra, and when billed separately they carry 5% GST.
Illustrative: ₹10,000 making charge + ₹500 GST → total bill ₹1,13,500.
When you sell jewellery back, it is valued on gold weight only; the making charge doesn't come back.

Do you compare making charges across jewellers before you buy?

Sources: an accounting software maker's GST-on-gold guide, a financial group's explainer on GST on jewellery, and two lenders' guides to gold resale value.

For education only. Not investment advice.
